title: Global leaders urged to join initiative to fight extreme inequality
content:
More than 1,500 academics and economists sign letter, calling growing gap between richest and poorest ‘a policy choice that can be reversed’

More than 1,500 academics and economists from 100-plus countries are urging global leaders to join an initiative against extreme inequality, calling current unfairness “a policy choice that can be reversed”.

Before the UN general assembly in New York next week, the experts have signed an open letter backing the International Panel on Inequality (IPI).

title: Johtajan nimissä tuleva kiireellinen maksupyyntö voi olla huijaus
content:
Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskukselle ilmoitetaan säännöllisesti huijauksista, joissa rikollinen esiintyy organisaation johtajana ja yrittää saada työntekijän siirtämään rahaa.

Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto Traficomin Kyberturvallisuuskeskukselle on raportoitu tapauksia, joissa huijari esittää olevansa esimerkiksi pääjohtaja, kunnanjohtaja, arkkipiispa, rehtori, pormestari tai pääsihteeri.

Huijarit selvittävät etukäteen organisaation johtoa ja työntekijöiden tehtäviä. Johtajan nimiin väärennetyllä viestillä rikollinen yrittää saada työntekijää tekemään maksun tai hankinnan. Valejohtaja voi pyytää työntekijää hankkimaan lahjakortteja liikelahjoiksi tai maksamaan laskun ilman tavanomaisia tarkastuskäytäntöjä. Usein verukkeena on, että johtaja on kokouksessa eikä voi vastata puheluihin, mutta asia pitää hoitaa kiireesti ja kyselemättä.

title: Googlen datakeskusinvestoinnit ja velkajarru puhuttivat Suhdannewebinaarissa
content:
Elinkeinoelämän tutkimuslaitos on nostanut kuluvan vuoden kasvuennustettaan. Bkt:n ennustetaan kasvavan tänä vuonna 1,7 prosenttia. Suomi myös pysyttelee kasvussa kiinni lähivuosina ja ensi vuonna kasvuksi ennustetaan jo liki kaksi prosentia. Erityisesti investoinnit tuottavat kasvusysäyksen. Ensi vuoden investointien kasvu tulee suurelta osin hakukoneyhtiö Googlen ilmoittamista datakeskusinvestoinneista. Suhdannewebinaarissa keskusteltiin hyvien kasvu-uutisten lisäksi myös velkajarrusta sekä työmarkkinoiden tilasta.

Elinkeinoelämän tutkimuslaitos julkisti vuoden toisen laajan talousennusteensa, syksyn Suhdanteen, torstaina 17.9. Etlan ennusteen mukaan Suomen kasvukäänne vahvistuu ja investointihanat aukeavat. Suomi myös pysyttelee kasvussa kiinni tulevina vuosina.

Suhdanteen julkistuswebinaarissa ensimmäisen Suhdanne-ennusteensa esitteli Etlan pääekonomisti Jenni Pääkkönen. Toimitusjohtaja Aki Kangasharju piti alkuun lyhyen talouspoliittisen katsauksen. Webinaarin juonsi Etlan viestintäjohtaja Tytti Sulander.

title: Datakeskuksenkin voi rakentaa puusta – puurakentamisesta, sivuvirroista ja hiilidioksidin hyödyntämisestä kasvua itäiseen Suomeen
content:
Puurakentaminen, metsätalouden sivuvirtojen hyödyntäminen ja talteen otetun hiilidioksidin jalostaminen voivat synnyttää Itä-Suomeen uutta yritystoimintaa ja korkeamman jalostusarvon tuotteita. Näitä mahdollisuuksia kehitetään Itäisen Suomen metsäbiotalouden uudet avaukset -kasvuohjelmassa, joka kokoaa yhteen kuusi maakuntaa, tutkimus- ja koulutusorganisaatioita sekä yrityksiä.

Kasvuohjelma koostuu kolmesta hankkeesta, joissa kehitetään metsätalouden sivuvirtojen käyttöä, teollista puurakentamista sekä hiilidioksidin talteenottoon ja hyödyntämiseen perustuvia ratkaisuja. Toiminta kattaa Etelä-Karjalan, Etelä-Savon, Kainuun, Kymenlaakson, Pohjois-Karjalan ja Pohjois-Savon.

Hankekokonaisuus on saanut valtioneuvostolta 2,5 miljoonan euron rahoituksen. Hankkeiden tulokset ovat hyödynnettävissä koko toiminta-alueella.

Kasvuohjelmaa koordinoiva Pohjois-Karjalan maakuntaliitto kokosi hankkeiden vetäjät ja yritysyhteistyökumppanit paneelikeskusteluun arvioimaan, millaisia mahdollisuuksia hankkeet avaavat uuden liiketoiminnan, investointien ja työpaikkojen synnylle Itä-Suomessa.

title: Nordic Perspectives on Education: A Two-Book Launch
content:
The books  (Brill) and (Stockholm University Press) present current knowledge on the research and practice of moral and citizenship education and of gifted education in the Nordic countries: Denmark, Iceland, Finland, Norway and Sweden. The Nordic countries share a common social and cultural history, together with a commitment to human rights and to the principles of non-discrimination, social justice, respect for life, human dignity and cultural diversity.

How are these values realised in the Nordic model of education and in the policy of “one school for all”? What kind of research and practice is needed in these fields today? And how can Nordic co-operation advance research and teaching across the Nordic countries?

Professor Kirsi Tirri (University of Helsinki) presents Nordic Perspectives on Moral and Citizenship Education, and Professor Valerie Margrain (Karlstad University) presents Nordic Perspectives on Gifted Education. A panel discussion follows the presentations, and the event closes with questions from the audience.

Panel members

  • Professor Peter Stadius, Centre for Nordic Studies (CENS), University of Helsinki

title: Eskarilaisten vanhemmat kutsutaan kirjastoon
content:
Miten lasten lukuinto syntyy? Samalla tavalla kuin miten he muutenkin elämää oppivat. Aikuisten esimerkin kautta.

Tämän ovat oivaltaneet Oriveden kirjastoammattilaiset, kirjastonhoitajat Mia Moilanen ja Ilkka Kaita-aho sekä varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja Tanja Riihimäki, jotka aloittivat pari vuotta sitten kirjaston vanhempainillat esikoululaisten perheille.

Syksyn alkaessa esikoulun aloittaneet ja heidän vanhempansa kutsutaan kirjastoon seikkailemaan ja saamaan tietoa siitä, mitä kaikkea kirjasto perheille tarjoaa.

Myös perheiden muut lapset ovat tervetulleita iltaan, sillä tarkoitus on herättää koko perheen yhteinen kiinnostus kirjojen maailmaan. Näin kirjaston avulla täydennetään neuvolasta alkanutta lukemisen pariin kannustamista.

Vanhempainillan aikana kirjasto on varattu pelkästään eskareiden perheille. Ensimmäisellä kerralla mukana oli sata osallistujaa, eli lähes kaikki pienen paikkakunnan esikoululaiset perheenjäsenineen.

title: Lokki-klassikon kajaanilainen tulkinta juhlii teatteria eli elämää
content:
Kajaanin kaupunginteatterin syksyn suurin ensi-ilta, Anton Tšehovin Lokki - tärkeintä on sietokyky, saa ensi-ilta 26.9.2026 Teatteritalon näyttämöllä. Esitys pohjautuu Elli Salon uuteen käännökseen Tšehovin klassikosta.

"Olen yhdessä työryhmän kanssa sovittanut näytelmän tapahtumaan nykypäivän Kajaanissa. Onhan Lokki myös jäähyväiseni Kajaanille ja toisaalta julmaa hyökkäyssotaa käyvän nyky-Venäjän kuvaaminen olisi aivan toinen esitys", kertoo lokakuussa työnsä Kajaanissa päättävä teatterinjohtaja Anni Mikkelsson.

Esityksessä joukko Kainuun kansallisteatterin vaikutuspiirissä pyöriviä ihmisiä on kokoontunut kesänviettoon vanhaan huvilaan Oulujärven rannalle. Seurueeseen kuuluu muun muassa nuori teatteria harrastava Konsta (Karoliina Niskanen), hänen äitinsä, Kainuusta maailmalle ponnistanut näyttelijä Irina Arkadina (Heidi Syrjäkari), oikealta nimeltään Irma Sorinen, ja tämän puoliso, kuuluisa helsinkiläinen kirjailija Trigorin (Antti Hovilainen).

Huvilalle saapuu myös nuori Nina (Milla Kuikka), joka haaveilee näyttelijän urasta. Onko siinä mitään järkeä? Pääseekö Nina lentoon?

title: EFF to Lawmakers: Ground AI Cybersecurity Rules in Best Practices
content:
With doomsday AI scenarios dominating the news, lawmakers are rightly concerned about reports concerning security breaches at major US AI labs, such as the OpenAI–Hugging Face incident and the many others reported in its aftermath. As they consider potentially regulating frontier AI, they should focus any new legislation on the immediate, demonstrated risks from those incidents. 

Post-incident reports show that the Hugging Face incident could have been mitigated or prevented by following longstanding cybersecurity best practices, like stronger sandboxing and monitoring. Any new legislation should focus on closing gaps in existing law to prevent AI companies from taking unreasonable risks with the public's security.

title: Global: Amid mounting threats, the UN’s next Secretary-General must be a staunch defender of international law

  • Artificial Intelligence and the need for a global, binding, transparent, and effective regulatory model
  • The Trump administration’s continuing attacks on international justice institutions
  • International and multilateral responses to Israel’s genocide in Gaza and ethnic cleansing in the West Bank
  • US-Israeli unlawful attacks on Iran, violations of international law and war crimes
  • Iran’s internal repression, including crimes against humanity
  • Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine
  • Sudan, the role of the UAE and the international community

title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
content:
Serrano’s return puts Ecuador’s justice system and rule of law under renewed scrutiny

Originally published on Global Voices

Screenshot taken from the YouTube video “José Serrano enters the El Encuentro prison after being deported from the United States,” by TVC Noticias; fair use.

Following the U.S. immigration system’s refusal to grant political asylum to former Interior Minister José Serrano Salgado, his deportation to Ecuador was carried out under the strictest security measures.

Serrano faces several investigations opened by the Attorney General’s Office of Ecuador, related to his tenure as a government official under former President Rafael Correa, as well as his alleged participation as the mastermind behind the assassination of journalist and former presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio. In the latter case, at the request of the Prosecutor’s Office, the judges ordered both pretrial detention and for him to be transferred to the El Encuentro prison (officially called the Santa Elena No. 1 Detention Center), located in the coastal province of Santa Elena.

title: Venezuela: Reform Needed for Rights Progress
content:
(Washington, DC) – Venezuela needs to take urgent measures and carry out institutional reforms to protect people’s basic rights, Human Rights Watch said today, following its first official visit to the country since 2008. 

Human Rights Watch visited Caracas this week and met with interim President Delcy Rodríguez, other government officials, human rights groups, members of the opposition, journalists, relatives of political prisoners, foreign diplomats, and others. Staff also visited Petare, a low-income neighborhood on the outskirts of Caracas. During its previous high-level visit, in 2008, Venezuelan authorities detained Human Rights Watch staff after they released a report and expelled them from the country.

“Interim President Delcy Rodríguez has overseen a pause to the most overt forms of repression in Venezuela,” said Federico Borello, deputy executive director at Human Rights Watch. “But in this fragile political moment, these gains will only become sustainable with robust institutional reforms and the release of all political prisoners.”

title: Maailman ympäri sähkörekalla - Tobias Wagner aloittaa kiertomatkan Hampurista sunnuntaina 20.9
content:
Saksalainen Tobias Wagner, joka tunnetaan myös nimellä ”Elektrotrucker”, aloittaa sunnuntaina IAA Transportation -messuilta maailmanympärimatkansa Mercedes-Benz eActros 600 -kuorma-autolla. Kokenut kuorma-autonkuljettaja ja sisällöntuottaja pyrkii olemaan ensimmäinen henkilö, joka kiertää maailman sähköisellä pitkän matkan kuorma-autolla noin vuoden kuluessa julkiseen latausinfraan tukeutuen.

Yli 30 maata ja 80 latausta

Wagnerin reitti on pituudeltaan noin 45 000 kilometriä ja kulkee noin 30 maan kautta Euroopassa, Aasiassa, Australiassa, Pohjois-Amerikassa ja Etelä-Amerikassa. Matka on tarkoitus toteuttaa enintään 80 latauspysähdyksellä. Löytöretken tavoitteena on dokumentoida sähköisen kuorma-auton teknistä suorituskykyä erilaisissa maantieteellisissä, ilmastollisissa ja infrastruktuuriin liittyvissä olosuhteissa sekä samalla edistää keskustelua tieliikenteen tavaraliikenteen latausinfrastruktuurin laajentamisesta.

title: Purkutaiteen 10-vuotisnäyttely käsittelee epämukavia aiheita mutta tarjoaa myös rauhoittumisen paikkoja
content:
Ai tätä trendisanalla ”immersiivinen taide” tarkoitetaan! Sen hoksaa, kun vaeltaa Arabian 135-korttelin käytävillä, entisissä studioissa ja luokkahuoneissa.

Keväällä avatussa Purkutaide-kollektiivin 10-vuotisnäyttelyssä Tämän haluan sanoa on esillä 55 tilataideteosta, joiden luomaan maailmaan voisi helposta upota koko päiväksi.

Kollektiivi uskoo moniaistillisuuteen ja kokemuksellisuuteen ja pyrkii siihen, että kaikki tuntevat olonsa tervetulleiksi. Sekä taideharrastajat että vähemmän kokeneet kävijät voivatkin löytää teosten kuva-, väri-, ääni- ja tekstimaailmasta uusia tapoja hahmottaa todellisuutta ja erilaisia yhteiskunnallisia ilmiöitä.

Asia on painavaa. Omiin huoneisiinsa erotellut teokset käsittelevät muun muassa pikamuotia, ekologista kriisiä, tuotantoeläinten asemaa, sukupuolta, mielenterveysongelmia ja muistisairautta.

Keskeinen teema on useammassakin teoksessa toistuva lähisuhdeväkivalta. Elina Holleyn, Miia Naparin ja Haydn Douet Lukiesin Varjolinnunlaulu avaa katsojan eteen huoneen, joka näyttää ensin tavalliselta asunnolta. Lähempi tarkastelu paljastaa vääristyneen, ahdistavan kulissin.

title: Janne Riiheläinen: Venäjä mittaa mielellään meidänkin kansalaistahtoamme
content:
Vieraiden valtioiden kuten Venäjän pahantekijät toivovat, ettemme olisi niin tunnollisia ja kunnollisia kuin nyt – koska sen jälkeen ne pystyisivät helpommin murentamaan yhteiskuntaamme.

Avaimenperässäni roikkui pitkään sellainen kolikosta käyvä
metallinpalanen, jolla sai vapautettua marketin sisäänkulun luona odottavat ostoskärryt mukaansa kauppaan.

Alun perin kolikoilla toimineen lukitussysteemin tarkoituksena oli varmistaa, että ihmiset palauttaisivat kärryt paikalleen käytön jälkeen, eivätkä jättäisi niitä pitkin parkkipaikkoja.

Jossain vaiheessa joku muutti mielensä ja kaupassa kärryjen luo ilmestyi lappu, jossa pyydettiin jättämään kärryt lukitsematta. Eikä niitä ole ainakaan omien havaintojen perusteella yhtään sen enempää levällään kuin ennenkään.

Tämä on Suomi. Tämä on sellaisten ihmisten maa, jossa suuri enemmistö hoitaa asioita kunnollisesti ja tunnollisesti.

Ostoskärryjen palauttaminen paikalleen nousee siitä samasta suhtautumisesta, jonka takia seisomme odottamassa tyhjän kadun äärellä punaisissa valoissa ja olemme valmiit puolustamaan maatamme, vaikka tulos olisi epävarma.

title: Wiki Loves Monuments: workshop & skrivstuga
content:
I september arrangerar vi den svenska grenen av Wiki Loves Monuments – en internationell fototävling där du bidrar till fri kunskap genom att fotografera det skyddade kulturarvet. Vi ordnar tävlingen i samarbete med Arbetslivsmuseernas samarbetsråd, vilket vi är väldigt glada över.

För att delta i tävlingen måste varje bild föreställa någon av Sveriges fornminnen, byggnadsminnen, K-märkta skepp/fritidsbåtar, kulturreservat eller arbetslivsmuseer. Bilderna släpps fria för hela världen att använda under Creative Commons-licens. Tack vare fokuset på just det skyddade kulturarvet byggs det upp en värdefull bildsamling som kan användas av exempelvis kulturarvsinstitutioner, journalister och forskare som vill synliggöra det skyddade kulturarvet.

Olidans kraftverk vid Göta älv i Trollhättan, Sverige Fotograf: Simiha, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons

  • Leta fram ett foto du tagit på det skyddade kulturarvet – eller gå ut och ta nya bilder.
  • Skapa ett konto på Wikimedia Commons (tar cirka 30 sekunder), om du inte redan har ett.
  • Ladda upp bilden via kartan eller uppladdningsverktyget. Du kan ladda upp hur många bilder du vill till och med 30 september.

title: Why Europe has been absent from the great AI safety debate
content:
Though Europe has measures that address how consumers might encounter AI, technology will impact them if the worst scenarios bear

Europe’s dilemma over AI was rendered in stark terms this week. The head of the continent’s central bank, Christine Lagarde, said Europeans have two options: shun the technology and lose out on growth; or embrace it and become dependent on tools developed by the US and China.

The great debate over AI safety that has erupted in recent days threatens to make the choice moot. If the worst scenarios come to bear – and experts have differing views on this – then the technology will impact the continent regardless.

The acclaimed British-Turkish author Elif Shafak is the winner of the Helena Vaz da Silva European Award for Raising Public Awareness on Cultural Heritage 2026. This European recognition pays tribute to Elif Shafak’s exceptional ability to bring Europe’s rich and diverse cultural heritage to life through her captivating storytelling, while responding to the challenges of our time with a powerful call for defending democracy, promoting solidarity, embracing cosmopolitanism and celebrating cultural diversity.

Elif Shafak – Photo credit: Ferhat Elik

title: Living Heritage Journeys: training on intangible cultural heritage in Kraków
content:
On 14 September 2026, Muzeum Krakowa hosted the training “Cultural Heritage Is More Than Monuments. Intangible Cultural Heritage in Practice – Safeguarding, Cooperation and New Challenges”, devoted to the specific characteristics of working with intangible cultural heritage and its role in museums, cultural institutions, public administration and the tourism sector. The training was led by Hanna Schreiber, our Chairholder.

Taking the 2003 UNESCO Convention for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage as its starting point, the training focused on living practices, knowledge, skills and traditions sustained by communities and transmitted from generation to generation. Participants explored differences between working with tangible and intangible cultural heritage, as well as challenges related to relationships with heritage bearers, participation, documentation, interpretation and the presentation of living heritage. The programme combined lectures with workshop activities.

title: Samtal om Själö hospital – kvinnoöden på 1800-talet
content:
Tidpunkt: 26.10 klockan 18.00-19.00
Plats: Finlandsinstitutet
Adress: Snickarbacken 4, Stockholm
Språk: svenska
Inträde: Gratis, men anmäl dig gärna här gärna här

Berättelsen om Själös kvinnoöden fortsätter att fascinera den finländska befolkningen och är igen aktuell i och med den nya finländska långfilmen Berätta för alla. På Själö, en ö i Åbolands skärgård, har ett av Finlands äldsta sjukhus fungerat i över 350 år. Men det var på 1800-talet som sjukhuset mer eller mindre förvandlades till ett sjukhus för enbart kvinnor. Kvinnor som beskrevs som obotligt sjuka men som i hög grad bestod av individer som samhället helt enkelt inte ville veta av. Och de allra flesta kvinnor som kom till Själö blev kvar resten av livet.

I samband med premiären av Berätta för alla ordnar vi ett samtal om Själös kvinnoöden och kanske ställer vi oss frågan, hade också jag hamnat där? För hur ser den samhälleliga blicken på kvinnor egentligen ut idag och vad är det med Själö som fortsätter att beröra?

I samtalet deltar bland annat författaren Johanna Holmström som skrivit boken Själarnas ö och skådespelaren Marketta Tikkanen från den högaktuella filmen Berätta för alla.

title: Keskustelu Seilin sairaalasta – Suomalaisten naisten kohtalo 1800-luvulla
content:
Aika: 26.10 kello 18.00-19.00
Paikka: Finlandsinstitutet
Osoite: Snickarbacken 4, Stockholm
Kieli: Ruotsi
Sisäänpääsy: Imainen mutta ilmoittaudu mielellään täällä

Tarina Seilin saaren naisten kohtalosta kiehtoo yhä suomalaisia, ja on nyt noussut jälleen pinnalle uuden elokuvan Kerro kaikille myötä. Turun saaristossa sijaitsevalla Seilin saarella sijaitsee yksi Suomen vanhimmista sairaaloista, joka on toiminut jo yli 350 vuotta. Mutta vasta 1800-luvulla sairaala muuttui käytännössä vain naisille tarkoitetuksi laitokseksi. Naiset, joita kuvailtiin parantumattomiksi yksilöiksi, olivat suurin osa vain ihmisiä joista yhteiskunta ei halunnut tietää. Monet näistä naisista jäivät Seilin saarelle loppuelämäkseen.

Kerro kaikille elokuvan yhteydessä järjestämme keskustelun Seilin naisten kohtalosta, kysyen ehkä myös itseltämme, olisinko minäkin jäänyt saarelle? Millainen on yhteiskunnan suhtautuminen naisiin nykyään, ja mikä Seilin saaressa vielä tänäkin päivänä koskettaa?

Keskusteluun osallistuvat muun muassa kirjailija Johanna Holmström, joka on kirjoittanut kirjan Sielujen saari, sekä näyttelijä Marketta Tikkanen, joka näyttelee elokuvassa Kerro kaikille.

title: Rage Against the Machines: From the Luddites to the AI Data Center Backlash
content: One often-repeated anecdote about Milton Friedman has the famous economist visiting a canal under construction in nineteen-sixties China. Noticing the sheer number of human laborers digging away with shovels, he asked the official in charge why they weren’t getting the work done faster with excavators and other modern machines. The bureaucrat explained to him that doing it by hand created more jobs. Friedman’s reply: “If it’s jobs you want, you should give those men spoons instead.” Whether or not this exchange ever actually happened, it illustrates a conflict that’s arisen more than once in the history of civilization, possibly since the dawn of industrialization — and at least since the heyday of the Luddites.

title: Moscow cries fraud abroad while fixing the vote at home
content:
Moscow routinely portrays elections in democratic countries as fraudulent and controlled from abroad. Yet Russia’s own parliamentary election offers no genuine political choice: the Kremlin controls the field and has eliminated even the possibility of voting against the war in Ukraine. As the war’s effects reach deeper into everyday life, growing public dissatisfaction is being kept out of the ballot box.

When post-Soviet states turn away from Russia, as Armenia or Moldova have done, Kremlin officials and aligned outlets usually blame Western interference. Yet Moscow has itself tries to influence elections through foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI), often alongside financial support for pro-Russian groups. Moldovan authorities say Russian agents spent about €200 million – nearly 1% of Moldova’s GDP – on vote-buying and disinformation during the country’s 2024 presidential election and EU referendum. Investigators later found that the sanctioned Russian organisation Evrazia had used similar tactics ahead of Armenia’s 2026 election. Moscow nevertheless portrayed EU assistance intended to counter such threats as election interference.

title: Bosnia Seizes 1.1 Tons of Synthetic Drugs Worth Up to €33 Million
content:
Authorities in Bosnia and Herzegovina have seized nearly 1.1 metric tonnes of dangerous synthetic cathinones with a potential street value of up to 33 million euros ($37.82 million), and arrested two suspects, marking the largest synthetic drug bust in the history of the nation of roughly 3.5 million people, the State Border Service announced.

The seized substance—an extremely dangerous stimulant used as a substitute for cocaine and ecstasy—carries a wholesale market value of 5 million euros ($5.73 million), but its street value skyrockets when broken down into individual grams sold at 20 to 30 euros ($23 to $34.50) each across the region, according to the Border Police. In addition to the massive drug cache, officers confiscated a firearm, mobile phones, corporate documentation, official stamps, and specialized full-face respirator masks with advanced air-filtration systems used to protect operators during chemical synthesis and drug "cooking." The Border Police noted that investigators have not yet established the origin or final destination of the shipment, as the investigation remains ongoing.

title: Judge Denies Efforts to End Oversight of Maricopa County Sheriff’s Office as Racial Profiling of Latinos Persists
content:
A federal judge has denied efforts to remove oversight of the Maricopa County Sheriff’s Office, saying the agency continues to show racial disparities in traffic arrests of Latinos — and that there is not enough evidence that efforts to improve would stick without legal monitoring.

In his 72-page ruling issued Sept. 10, U.S. District Judge G. Murray Snow stressed Sheriff Jerry Sheridan’s role in the department’s racial profiling since the start of the case more than a decade ago, including fighting court-ordered reforms and stymieing investigations. Sheridan was the No. 2 under former Sheriff Joe Arpaio when the county was found out of compliance with federal law.

“Then Chief Deputy, now Sheriff, Sheridan in particular was found to have abused his authority over MCSO’s internal affairs process by obstructing and manipulating misconduct investigations and disciplinary proceedings — including those involving himself — to shield deputies and Command Staff from accountability and undermine the enforcement of remedies designed to address the constitutional violations against the Plaintiff class,” the judge wrote in an opinion that mentions Sheridan 30 times.

title: OKM: selvitys esittää tekijänoikeusjärjestöille lakisääteistä asiavaltuutta
content:
Opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön julkaisema selvitys ehdottaa, että tekijänoikeusjärjestöjen asiavaltuudesta säädetään lailla. Muutos helpottaa teosten luvattomaan käyttöön puuttumista erityisesti silloin, kun käyttö koskee suurta määrää teoksia.

Taiteilijan voi olla vaikea valvoa, miten hänen teoksiaan käytetään. Tekijänoikeusjärjestöillä on oikeuksien hallinnointiin valtuutuksia, mutta ne eivät voi lähtökohtaisesti viedä omissa nimissään tekijänoikeuden loukkauksia oikeuteen, jollei yksinoikeuksia ole siirretty järjestöille. Asia nousi esiin korkeimman oikeuden (KKO 2024:53) ratkaisussa, jossa KKO katsoi, ettei Kopiostolla ollut asiavaltuutta eli oikeutta esittää omissa nimissään vaatimuksia tekijänoikeuden loukkausta koskevassa jutussa.

Bruunin mukaan tekijänoikeusjärjestöillä on välitön intressi valvoa oikeuksia, sillä ne hallinnoivat tekijänoikeuksia ja lähioikeuksia kollektiivisesti, oikeudenhaltijoiden yhteiseen lukuun.

title: Sweden’s 2026 election: Social Democrats lost the battle but won the war?
content:
In last week’s parliamentary elections in Sweden, the Swedish Social Democratic Party undoubtedly became the largest party, with the support of 28 per cent of voters and a strong chance of leading the next government by replacing the incumbent right-wing one. Yet, within Swedish Social Democracy, a sense of dissatisfaction prevails. How did this come about?

In a fragmented parliament with eight parties, 28 per cent of the popular vote is not a disaster – especially not from a European perspective. When conservative Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson steps down after four years, it will be the first time since 1994 that a Swedish government has lost power after only a single term.

Yet the 2-point drop to 28 per cent remains historically weak for the Social Democrats. Above all, the contrast with the preceding term is striking. For periods, the party polled between 35 and 37 per cent, and as recently as August, the centre-left opposition bloc held a lead of around ten percentage points. When the results came in, however, the election was decided by a razor-thin margin.

title: What might Canada’s EU ‘associate membership’ look like, and is it even a possibility?
content:
In a speech to the European Parliament, Canadian prime minister Mark Carney declared that “Europe and Canada are stronger together”. He also backed an offer made by the president of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, one day earlier for Canada to become the first “associate member” of the bloc.

“Canada welcomes this ambition,” he said. “An alliance for the future is a unique, positive approach that we will define together.” But what might associate membership look like, how significant is von der Leyen’s offer in the history of the EU’s relations with external states, and how likely is it to come into being?

Canada already has a preferential trade deal with the EU in the form of the 2016 Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (Ceta). This type of free-trade agreement is typical of the sort of legal instrument used by the EU to manage relations with its main international partners.

But one way in which the EU could upgrade Ottawa’s relations with Brussels would be to look to the template of the “association agreements” the EU uses to bring neighbouring countries into closer alignment with its policies and programmes.

title: Russia’s Rigged Elections Still Serve a Purpose
content:
The outcome of Russia’s parliamentary elections is predetermined. Yet the Kremlin cares about much more than the figures announced once the ballots are (mis)counted.

Vladimir Putin’s regime can of course falsify almost any result. Independent election monitoring has been largely destroyed, voting has been extended over three days, and electronic ballots are difficult to verify. But an entirely fictional election would cease to perform its most important function. It would tell the Kremlin nothing about the discipline of its officials, the resilience of regional elites, or the state’s ability to mobilize the population.

Russian elections are therefore more than a falsified vote count. They are a nationwide examination of the Putin system. Citizens play a secondary role. The real examinees are governors, bureaucrats, directors of state institutions, and party functionaries.

From September 18 to 20, Russians elect a new State Duma. At the same time, more than 2,200 regional and municipal elections will take place across the country, distributing approximately 20,700 elected offices and legislative seats.
snippet: The outcome of Russia’s parliamentary elections is predetermined. Yet the Kremlin cares about much more than the figures announced once the ballots are (mis)counted.

title: California’s Newsom signs executive order to explore new AI rules, consider ‘kill switch’
content:
California Gov. Gavin Newsom issued an executive order on Friday to speed up two AI laws he recently signed and explore proposals like requiring that AI companies develop a “kill switch” for their most advanced models.

The order comes after the Democrat told POLITICO this week he was mulling his options to take further action on AI safety, including a possible special legislative session to address recent safety concerns set off by AI researchers’ warnings that the technology could pose an existential risk to humanity and prominent autonomous hacking incidents.

Newsom said his executive action was also driven by federal inaction, after President Donald Trump responded to the warnings by dismissing them as a “hoax” and saying the only guardrails AI needs are his presidency. On Friday, Newsom urged Trump and Congress to adopt California’s AI framework or use the state’s existing regulations as a floor for federal rules.

“The federal government’s abject failure to create any form of meaningful AI oversight or accountability should alarm every American, especially when AI CEOs themselves are begging for regulation,” Newsom said in his press release.

title: How Poland “planned to occupy Czech lands” – coordinated information operation exposed
content:
Facebook posts called on people to gather for a protest in the Czech border town of Třinec on Saturday, 29th of August. The protest never took place. The Třinec municipal authorities had already announced that no public event had been registered, while the Czech Republic’s largest trade union, KOVO, which represents metalworking and industrial workers and whose logo was used in the protest advertising materials, denied any connection with the action. Moreover, Polish and Czech media had already exposed the disinformation campaign, which involved fake social media profiles, fabricated media outlets, forged documents and even an unauthorised publication of an article on the website of a public broadcaster.

At the beginning of August, disinformation began circulating claiming that Poland planned to take over more than 600 hectares of Czech territory. According to an analysis by the Czech news portal Seznam Zprávy, several social media accounts in the Czech Republic circulated a document purportedly sent by the Polish government to the Czech authorities. It allegedly demanded that land with a total area of 638.44 hectares be handed over to Poland.

title: Russia’s parliamentary elections will not be a referendum on the Ukraine war – or anything, really
content:
Russia is not a democracy. However, Russia does have elections – many of them, in fact.

From September 18-20, Russian voters will elect their national parliamentary representatives (to the Russian State Duma), as well as 11 governors, deputies to 39 regional assemblies, and deputies to other lower-level representative bodies.

The elections will be the first parliamentary elections since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. However, this will not be a barometer of public opinion about the war, the state of the Russian economy, or, well, anything.

Russians have many reasons to be disenchanted with President Vladimir Putin’s regime. The war is now in its fifth year, with an estimated 1.4 million battlefield casualties (including 450,000 deaths). Some 30,000 Russian soldiers are either being killed or injured a month. Ukraine is also increasingly bringing the war home to Russians with frequent drone attacks.

Yet, these elections will be carefully stage-managed to guarantee a favourable result – and a continued strong mandate – for Putin’s party.

title: What does a stronger Europe actually require? Demos Helsinki’s comments on the State of the Union.
content:
President von der Leyen highlighted in her State of the Union speech on 16 September a Europe that must become more capable of acting on its own terms: stronger in defence, more secure in energy, more competitive in technology, and more resilient in the face of climate and social pressures.

However, strengthening Europe is not only a question of ambition. It raises difficult questions about dependencies, governance and what we actually mean by resilience. Drawing on research from three EU-funded projects, we look at some of the tensions behind the speech: what technological sovereignty requires in practice, how climate resilience depends on institutions that can work across policy silos, and why Europe’s strength cannot be measured solely through current economic indicators. 

“Europe will need its own capabilities”

“Europe will need its own capabilities”

“We need to stay in the race” 

“We need to stay in the race” 

President von der Leyen made technological capacity a clear part of Europe’s push for greater strategic autonomy. But strengthening technological autonomy is considerably more difficult in practice than the political ambitions might suggest.

title: Personal Research Ontologies for Personal Open Science | Proceedings of the 14th ACM Collective Intelligence Conference
content: Abstract: As researchers conduct their work, they incrementally construct a personal research ontology: a rich, personal understanding of their field and its phenomena. Yet most of this knowledge remains internalized, with only fragments surfacing in publications. This position paper argues that research is fundamentally an act of personal ontology construction and proposes Personal Open Science (POS), a lightweight method for externalizing a researcher’s personal research ontology for downstream use. The method requires no machine learning or language models, and it centers on the researcher rather than on the publication, the traditional focal unit of Open Science. Building on daily reading habits and a minimal annotation scheme, the approach adds little overhead while producing a structured, explorable representation of a researcher’s interests, influences, and expertise. I demonstrate the method through my own practice of annotating over 45,000 documents across a decade of research. title: ‘A map is never neutral’: meet the cartographers who took on centuries of western bias
content:
Equal Earth projection, adopted by the UN last week, provides an alternative to 16th-century Mercator display

Three cartographers have spoken of their astonishment at the UN’s near-universal adoption of a map they created to more accurately show the sizes of Africa and Europe, even though they have received a few complaints from some disgruntled diplomats.

The creators of the Equal Earth projection aimed to provide an alternative to the dominant 16th-century Mercator display, which critics have long faulted for giving the impression that northern hemisphere nations are larger than they are – and therefore subtly reinforcing perceptions of where global strength lies.

title: Digitizing Tunisia’s Documentary Heritage: From the National Archives to Future GLAM Collaboration
content:
Tunis, Tunisia — A one-month Wikipedian in Residence project at the National Documentation Center of Tunisia has resulted in the digitization of more than 3,000 historical documents, opening new opportunities for the preservation, dissemination, and reuse of Tunisia’s documentary heritage through Wikimedia projects.

The residency was carried out by three Wikipedians in Residence from Wikimedia Tunisia: Mounir Touzri, Houssem Eddin Boubakri, and Naim Garboussi. The team worked in collaboration with the National Documentation Center’s Sub-department of National Archives to identify, digitize, organize, and prepare historical materials for wider public access.

A major part of the project focused on the digitization of magazines published between 1955 and 1983, together with other historical documents related to Tunisia’s history.

The main subjects represented in the digitized collection include sport, art, and cinema, as well as other aspects of Tunisia’s cultural and historical development. The materials contain photographs, articles, reports, and other documentary sources that can provide valuable information about different periods of Tunisian history.

title: Anna Maria Fjordbøge discussed ethnographic findings on digitalisation and judicial independence
content:
In her presentation, “Blurring boundaries? Negotiating digitalization, efficiency efforts and tripartition of power at the Danish courts” Fjordbøge discussed the ongoing digitalisation of the Danish courts and the penal chain.

The presentation drew on findings from a year-long ethnographic fieldwork project examining how digitalisation and efforts to improve the efficiency of court processes are discussed and implemented in the Danish judiciary. Particular attention was paid to debates concerning the constitutionality of recent digitalisation initiatives, as well as to interactions between administrative and managerial professionals and legal professionals.

A central theme of the presentation was judicial independence. Fjordbøge approached independence as an essentially contested concept within the Danish judiciary and legal policy: different groups of actors may attach different meanings to what judicial independence entails and how it should be protected in practice.

title: Oversight Reports Echo HRW Findings on US Immigration Abuses
content:
On September 11, the US Department of Homeland Security’s Office of Inspector General published reports outlining findings from visits to Krome North Service Processing Center and the now-shuttered “Alligator Alcatraz,” immigration detention facilities in Florida. The oversight body found that the facilities failed to comply with DHS standards, including for medical care, environmental health and safety, and—in the case of Krome—use of force.

One of the most disturbing findings at Alligator Alcatraz was the use of “small metal enclosures”—essentially cages—to hold detainees for up to two hours, which the inspector general said “does not align with standards for humane treatment.” The report states that in at least one case, this may have been used as a “disciplinary tool.”

The inspector general said that confining people in cages “presents significant risks to detainee health and well-being.”

While Alligator Alcatraz officially closed on June 25, there are more than 200 active immigration detention facilities throughout the United States. Human Rights Watch has found cruel, inhuman, and degrading treatment at several of these facilities, including Krome.

title: Suomen ensimmäiset F-35A-hävittäjät saapuivat Rovaniemelle – yksi jäi matkasta
content:
Suomen ensimmäiset omat F-35A-hävittäjät saapuivat perjantaina maahan, kun kaksi uudenkarheaa monitoimihävittäjää laskeutui Rovaniemen lentokentälle Hornet-hävittäjien saattamina.

Koneet lennettiin Suomeen perjantaina Portugalin Azoreilta. Määränpäänä oli Lapin lennoston tukikohta Rovaniemellä, jossa sijaitsee Ilmavoimien ensimmäinen F-35-tukikohta.

Odotetun kolmen uuden hävittäjän sijasta perille saapui perjantaina vain kaksi konetta. Paikallisen lentoharrastajan Azoreilla aiemmin päivällä julkaisemalla videolla näkyi, että vain viisi kuudesta siirtolennolla olleesta F-35A-hävittäjästä nousi ilmaan Terceiran lentokentältä.

SUOMEEN saapuneiden hävittäjien lisäksi Lajesista lähti kolme Belgiaan suunnannutta F-35A-hävittäjää, jotka lensivät Lajesiin suomalaishävittäjien kanssa. Suomen ja Belgian hävittäjiä saattamaan lähti yhteensä kaksi KC-135 Stratotanker -ilmatankkauskonetta.

title: Luke ja Saamelaiskäräjät tiivistävät yhteistyötä – saamelaisten ääni halutaan mukaan tutkimukseen aiempaa varhemmin
content:
Luonnonvarakeskus (Luke) ja Saamelaiskäräjät tiivistävät yhteistyötään saamelaisten kotiseutualueella tehtävässä tutkimuksessa. Sopimus allekirjoitettiin Inarissa perjantaina 11. syyskuuta.

Painopisteinä ovat muun muassa saamelaisten perinteiset elinkeinot, kuten kalastus, poronhoito, metsästys, keräily ja saamelaiskäsityö. Lisäksi tutkimus- ja kehittämistyötä tehdään luonnonvarojen kestävästä hyödyntämisestä, maan ja vesien käytöstä, saamelaismatkailusta sekä näihin liittyvistä yhteiskunnallisista kysymyksistä.

”On tärkeää, että saamelaisten ääni kuuluu tutkimuksessa. Tämä yhteistyösopimus vahvistaa Saamelaiskäräjien mahdollisuuksia osallistua tutkimustarpeiden tunnistamiseen ja tutkimuksen suunnitteluun jo varhaisessa vaiheessa, sanoo Saamelaiskäräjien puheenjohtaja Pirita Näkkäläjärvi Luonnonvarakeskuksen tiedotteessa.

Sopimuksen mukaan Luke ja Saamelaiskäräjät suunnittelevat yhdessä tutkimus- ja kehittämishankkeita ja hakevat niille rahoitusta. Osapuolet tapaavat vuosittain arvioidakseen tuloksia ja uusia tutkimustarpeita sekä sopiakseen seuraavan vuoden yhteistyöstä.

title: Your AI doomsday questions answered: ‘Why aren’t these companies being held to account?’
content:
After a week of alarming warnings about artificial intelligence’s potential to destroy the world as we know it, our technology reporters answered your questions on the reality of the AI threat

IcommentthereforeIam asks: Given our senses, emotions, memory and moods, is it ever going to be accepted that humanly conscious AI is fantasy?

Dan: This is a serious question that has even rattled Richard Dawkins, the evolutionary biologist. He may not believe that God is real but he does believe that AI is conscious - or at least the chatbot he was using, which he called Claudia. “You may not know you are conscious, but you bloody well are,” he wrote.

And he’s not the first. In 2022 Google fired an engineer who went public with his belief that a company-developed AI had feelings. At the more troubling end of this belief, there are countless examples of people becoming overly attached to, and influenced by, AI chatbots – including cases of psychosis.

title: Seilin sairaala – Suomalaisten naisten kohtalo 1800-luvulla
content:
Aika: 26.10 kello 18.00-19.00
Paikka: Finlandsinstitutet
Osoite: Snickarbacken 4, Stockholm
Kieli: Ruotsi
Sisäänpääsy: Imainen mutta ilmoittaudu mielellään täällä

Tarina Seilin saaren naisten kohtalosta kiehtoo yhä suomalaisia, ja on nyt noussut jälleen pinnalle uuden elokuvan Kerro kaikille myötä. Turun saaristossa sijaitsevalla Seilin saarella sijaitsee yksi Suomen vanhimmista sairaaloista, joka on toiminut jo yli 350 vuotta. Mutta vasta 1800-luvulla sairaala muuttui käytännössä vain naisille tarkoitetuksi laitokseksi. Naiset, joita kuvailtiin parantumattomiksi yksilöiksi, olivat suurin osa vain ihmisiä joista yhteiskunta ei halunnut tietää. Monet näistä naisista jäivät Seilin saarelle loppuelämäkseen.

Kerro kaikille elokuvan yhteydessä järjestämme keskustelun Seilin naisten kohtalosta, kysyen ehkä myös itseltämme, olisinko minäkin jäänyt saarelle? Millainen on yhteiskunnan suhtautuminen naisiin nykyään, ja mikä Seilin saaressa vielä tänäkin päivänä koskettaa?

Keskusteluun osallistuvat muun muassa kirjailija Johanna Holmström, joka on kirjoittanut kirjan Sielujen saari, sekä näyttelijä Marketta Tikkanen, joka näyttelee elokuvassa Kerro kaikille.

title: Iraq Sentences Former Electricity Director General to Seven Years for illicit enrichment
content:
An Iraqi anti-corruption court has sentenced the former director general of a state electricity distribution firm to seven years in prison for illicit enrichment, ordering him to forfeit nearly $20 million in restitution and fines as part of a sweeping crackdown on graft in the country’s power sector.

The official, Alaa Samir Rashid Shukr Al-Jubouri, who headed the state-owned General Company of Electricity Distribution (Middle Region), was convicted by Iraq’s Central Criminal Court for Combating Corruption. According to the country’s Integrity Commission, Rashid amassed unexplained wealth exceeding 5.5 billion Iraqi dinars (about $4.2 million) along with an additional $5.5 million in U.S. currency.

The court ordered Rashid to return the illicit gains and levied an equivalent fine, bringing his total financial liability to approximately $19.4 million. Judges also upheld a freeze on his movable and immovable assets, paving the way for seizure.

title: Tennessee Lawmakers Demand Answers on Safety in State Youth Prisons
content:
Four Democratic Tennessee state lawmakers sent a letter to the Department of Children’s Services demanding answers about safety and oversight in the state’s juvenile justice facilities.

The letter cites a recent WPLN and ProPublica investigation that found that juvenile justice facilities run by Tennessee businessman Jason Crews repeatedly failed to report abuse of children and other serious incidents to the state as required. The reporting involved interviews with dozens of former staff and youth, along with a review of emergency call logs, company records and state documents. Crews and his company Wayne Halfway House run all three of the state’s highest-security youth prisons. 

“The allegations that serious physical and sexual abuse, dangerous restraints, injuries, and other critical incidents have gone unreported by WHH demand an urgent, transparent, and independently verifiable response from the Department of Children’s Services,” lawmakers wrote.

title: A State of the Union bereft of coherence and clarity
content:
The State of the Union is a very special exercise for the president of the European Commission. Its main purpose is to show that the Commission has a clear vision to tackle the numerous challenges and perils the Union is facing, and that, despite the complex environment, there is an experienced pilot at the helm. Indeed, this year’s statement takes place at an exceptionally difficult time, as President Ursula von der Leyen has said from the outset. Her description and diagnosis of the geopolitical and internal challenges and transformation are accurate enough. But what about her answers and political solutions?

Von der Leyen likes to use a certain degree of pathos to appeal to emotions. That is why she invites some special guests to materialise these emotions. One may doubt if pathos is the best way to respond to people’s fears and expectations and to gain trust.

title: How Spain’s socialist-led government fumbled the Ceuta crisis, and put itself on the back foot
content:
The crisis in Ceuta has put Pedro Sánchez’s government on the defensive, just as Spain’s political actors return from the summer break. Weeks after the crisis began, the situation remains unresolved. Of the estimated 80,000 migrants who entered Ceuta in late July, 5,482 remain.

Fierce debate has raged over the government’s handling of the crisis, with protests across the country, a deepening culture war, and violent attacks on migrants in Ceuta – some allegedly carried out by Spanish soldiers.

Within Spain, the crisis has barely left the headlines for the last seven weeks. While a permanent solution has yet to emerge, one thing is clear: the government has missed a vital chance to frame the issue of migration on its own terms.

This year’s mass regularisation saw Sánchez taking the initiative. In doing so, he cast himself – and by extension Spain – as a champion of human rights, one who pushes back against Europe’s prevailing anti-migrant sentiment, placing the economy and inclusion at the centre of the debate.

title: Russia’s Election Campaign Puts Governors on the Hook
content:
In the upcoming Russian parliamentary elections from September 18-20, governors will be the top candidate in 45 of the ruling United Russia party’s 57 regional rosters (80%).

Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin, who is also considered the governor of the Russian capital, ranks second on the five-candidate federal party roster. Adding other governors running in second place brings the total number of such officials featured at the top of United Russia’s regional and federal rosters to 55. Since 2016, the number of governors heading the party’s rosters has risen sharply: from 19 in that year, to 49 in 2021 and now 55.

This growing reliance is telling. Regional leaders are not merely electoral “coattails” or “locomotives”; they also bear personal responsibility for results in their regions. Voting for United Russia can thus increasingly be seen as a referendum on governors’ approval, shifting accountability for the party’s performance onto their shoulders, and potentially becoming a major pain in their necks. For the party, it’s a useful corrective since it both keeps political elites in step and devolves any electoral uncertainty onto other officials.

title: Behind the Blog: Eating the Internet
content:
This is Behind the Blog, where we share our behind-the-scenes thoughts about how a few of our top stories of the week came together. This week, we discuss just doing it, machines that eat the internet, and an eavesdropping watch.

EMANUEL: It is a foundational, defining feature of 404 Media, but I sometimes forget that when I’m having trouble with a story, I need to just do it. 

This is most of all true when it comes to reporting. I spent a couple of weeks looking into AI generated music on Spotify appearing under the names of real artists. It’s an issue I and many other publications have reported on in the past, but whenever I look into it I am shocked by how prevalent the issue is. If you talk to any musician or spend some time clicking around music platforms yourself, you’re going to quickly find hundreds of examples of this abuse of the digital music distribution system.

title: The International Olympic Committee wants mental health screening in elite sports. Here’s why
content:
Elite athletes are exposed to a range of sport-specific factors that can heighten their vulnerability to mental ill-health. These include injury, overtraining, burnout, performance-related pressures, intense public scrutiny and social media abuse.

Despite these risks, athletes are often perceived as models of psychological resilience, able to withstand the inherent tension of competing at the highest levels. The mythology of the “mentally tough” or bullet-proof athlete often obscures the reality of elite sport’s mental toll.

This is why the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is encouraging elite level sports around the world to develop stronger mental health protocols for athletes.

I was one of a global network of academics who helped develop the IOC’s recently updated expert consensus statement on mental health in elite sport.

With an emphasis on better early intervention, a key element is mental health screening. This is where athletes complete brief, structured questions to identify possible signs of mental health difficulties that may warrant further assessment.

title: First Wikimedia Kimaragang Meeting: The First Step in Preserving Language and Heritage Online
content:
From Wiki Kent Club to Kota Marudu: Sowing the Seeds of the Free Knowledge Movement in the Kimaragang Community

I first discovered the Wikimedia world while studying for my Bachelor’s Degree in Teaching, majoring in Kadazandusun Language, through my involvement with the Kent Wiki Club. This experience directly led me to become an active contributor in the Kadazandusun community.

Since becoming active in 2023 through Wiktionary, Wikipedia, and Wikimedia Commons, we have achieved many milestones together. These include translating thousands of Kadazandusun words into Malay on Wiktionary, establishing the Kadazandusun Wikipedia, and uploading over 2,000 cultural photos during major events like the Kaamatan Festival. We also successfully built strategic partnerships with various external organizations.

From 2024 to 2025, I was trusted to lead the Wiki Kent Club. This leadership opportunity taught me valuable lessons about internal and external management, especially regarding organizational collaboration, such as when organizing the Wikitour, which required us to contact the management of IPGM Rajang Campus to secure agreement for a joint program.

title: Philippines: Authorities must ensure right to protest as fresh anti-corruption demonstrations planned
content:
Ahead of planned demonstrations marking one year since mass anti-corruption protests took place in the Philippines on 21 September 2025, Ritz Lee Santos III, Executive Director of Amnesty International Philippines, said:

“As people prepare to take to the streets once more to demand accountability for corruption, Philippine authorities must ensure the right to peaceful assembly is protected and refrain from using excessive force. The authorities must not repeat the mistakes of last year’s violent response to peaceful protest.

“One year on, protesters arrested during the 2025 demonstrations continue to face charges, while authorities have failed to thoroughly, independently and impartially investigate allegations of police violence.

“Charges against those who exercised their right to peaceful assembly should be immediately dropped. Any use of force by police must be strictly necessary, proportionate and in line with international human rights standards.

title: Türkiye: LGBT Rights Crackdown Strikes at Rule of Law
content:
(Istanbul, September 18, 2026) – The Turkish government’s major crackdown on groups and activists defending the rights of lesbian, gay, bisexual, and transgender (LGBT) people threatens the rule of law and fundamental rights in Türkiye, Human Rights Watch said today. 

On September 12-14, 2026, coordinated police raids targeted seven groups defending the rights of LGBT people and two supporting people living with HIV, as well as bars and nightclubs in Istanbul, Ankara, Izmir, Aydın, and Mersin. Police arrested at least 112 people, with 82 still detained under court order. At least 24 of them are LGBT activists, founders or executives of the targeted groups, and one is a journalist.  

“This crackdown is a blatant attempt to criminalize and marginalize LGBT people and silence the groups that stand up for their rights,” said Benjamin Ward, deputy Europe and Central Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “The Turkish government should immediately release LGBT activists and others arrested without credible evidence of criminal wrongdoing and end its campaign against LGBT groups.”

title: Viranomaiset kiinnostuivat Googlen keskustyömaiden hakkuista
content:
Lupa- ja valvontavirasto (LVV) on pyytänyt Muhoksen kunnalta ja Kajaanin kaupungilta selvityksiä niiden datakeskushankkeista ja työmailla aloitetuista oheistöistä.

STT uutisoi torstaina Suomen luonnonsuojeluliiton epäilevän hankkeen työmaita laittomista hakkuista.

Virasto on pyytänyt selvityksiä myös alueille datakeskukset rakennuttavan Googlen tytäryhtiöltä Tuike Finlandilta. LVV haluaa asiaan selvennyksiä muun muassa hankkeiden luvituksesta sekä alueilla tehdyistä toimenpiteistä.

– Selvitysten perusteella Lupa- ja valvontavirasto tarkastelee, millaisiin mahdollisiin toimenpiteisiin on tarpeen ryhtyä. Näiden hankkeiden osalta myös kunnalla on oma vastuu hankkeiden toteuttamiskelpoisuuden ja lainmukaisuuden valvonnasta, viraston ympäristöosaston yksikön päällikkö Sari Myllyoja sanoo tiedotteessa.

title: Georgia Court Sentences Ex-Security Chief to 13 Years in Prison in Corruption Case
content:
The former head of the State Security Service of Georgia was found guilty this week of accepting more than $2 million in bribes and sentenced to 13 years in prison, as a corruption crackdown continues against former senior officials from the ruling Georgian Dream party. 

Grigol Liluashvili, who headed the security service from 2019 until 2025, was arrested last December following raids on his home and those of two other former ruling party elites.

Tbilisi City Court Judge Nino Tarashvili on Wednesday found Liluashvili guilty of “accepting bribes on an especially large scale,” said the Prosecutor's Office of Georgia’s press release announcing the verdict. 

Liluashvili’s lawyer Lana Tsertsvadze reacted outside the courtroom, telling reporters it was an “unjust verdict” that she would appeal.

“The defense and Mr. Grigol Liluashvili anticipated an acquittal because there was not a single piece of evidence in the case to prove his guilt,” Tsertsvadze said in a video interview. “Mr. Grigol Liluashvili will seek to establish his innocence through legal avenues. This unfounded, unlawful, and unjust decision will be challenged in the Court of Appeals.”
snippet: The former head of the State Security Service of Georgia was found guilty this week of accepting more than $2 million in bribes and sentenced to 13 years in prison, as a corruption crackdown continues

title: “A Clear Watering Down”: Drug Transparency Bill Stripped of Critical Provisions Ahead of Senate Vote
content:
Landmark legislation designed to alert consumers to where their drugs were made is headed for a full Senate vote, but safety experts say the transparency bill has been stripped of two of its most critical provisions.

The Clear Labels Act was introduced earlier this year by Sens. Rick Scott, R-Fla., and Kirsten Gillibrand, D-N.Y., after lawmakers and drug safety experts called for more transparency in the industry. Last year, a ProPublica investigation revealed that the U.S. kept importing generic drugs from foreign factories after inspectors had identified quality and safety lapses at the sites, including leaks, mold and contaminated water.

Medications made at these facilities were linked to thousands of reported adverse reactions in patients.

The bill aims to allow doctors and patients to see on the label exactly where a medication was made — details that had largely been withheld until now, even from Congress. Current generic drug labels often include only the location of the packager or distributor, which can be thousands of miles away from the actual manufacturer.

title: How a traditional Nordic way of eating could help you live longer
content:
We live in Denmark, which consistently ranks as one of the world’s healthiest countries. The modern Danish diet, however, may not be quite so world-leading – with many Danes consuming high levels of sugar, salt and convenience food.

Yet, go back a few generations and science is increasingly showing that many of the staple foods of our grandparents’ generation.

Think homemade rye bread, herring, root vegetables and berries – can significantly reduce your risk of chronic disease and help you live longer.

Often described as the Mediterranean diet of the north, the Nordic diet is a predominantly plant-based diet rooted in traditional Nordic foods.

Health Gap / Sundhedskløften is a collaborative series from The Conversation UK and Denmark’s Videnskab.dk exploring what the two countries can learn from each other when it comes to health and wellbeing.

From cycling and alcohol to inequality, healthcare and everyday habits, the series looks beyond hospitals and medical treatment to explore how culture, politics and society shape the way people live – and how healthy they are.

title: The Big Day Looms for Putin’s Election Fixers
content:
Sergei Kiriyenko became head of the Kremlin’s political bloc after the 2016 State Duma elections. His predecessor, Vyacheslav Volodin, lost his position partly because turnout in those elections fell below 50%, a show of popular apathy too notable to ignore.

Volodin had not wanted to overheat the system. But he worked hard to construct a network of sham public organizations around Putin, each offering unconditional support for the president and his policies. The All-Russia People’s Front was the clearest example.

Under Volodin’s model, a dependent or loyal electorate was expected to turn out on election day. This ensured predictability while also providing a measure of legitimacy. Protest-minded citizens, meanwhile, were expected to stay away from the polls and then draw the obvious conclusion: the authorities had won thanks to the votes of the loyal electorate.

title: Georgia: Critics Jailed for Online Speech
content:
(Berlin, September 18, 2026) – Georgian authorities are using vague administrative offenses to jail or heavily fine people for online speech, deepening the government’s crackdown on freedom of expression, Human Rights Watch said today.

Since June 2026, a new Ministry of Internal Affairs unit has monitored social media and referred hundreds of posts to courts to be tried for speech-related charges, such as insult or profanity. In July, courts sentenced a journalist and an activist to 14 and 25 days of detention, respectively, for online statements deemed insulting, and in September, authorities opened proceedings against a blogger over a Facebook comment deemed profane. 

“Statements can be crude or disrespectful, but that does not justify jailing people for what they say about public officials,” said Hugh Williamson, Europe and Central Asia director at Human Rights Watch. “Detention or substantial fines for nonviolent expression under vague rules, combined with monitoring social media, pose a serious threat to free expression in Georgia.”

title: ”Ne syövät taloutemme aamupalaksi” – Kansanedustaja kehottaa nostamaan katseen taskulaskimesta
content:
Kansanedustaja Saara Hyrkön (vihr.) mukaan EU:n taloussääntöjen puolustuspoikkeamaa tulisi jatkaa myös vuoden 2028 jälkeen. Energiapoikkeaman Hyrkkö laajentaisi koskemaan ympäristöturvallisuutta.

Tiedotteessaan Hyrkkö patistaa hallitusta aktiivisiin toimiin EU:ssa. Hän toteaa seuranneensa viime kuukausien talouskeskustelua turhautuneena.

Kokoomusjohtoinen hallitus on tehnyt alijäämäisen budjetin ja toisaalla ehdotellut uusia veronalennuksia. Samaan aikaan liike nyt on ilmoittanut irtaantuvansa velkajarrusovusta. Vihreiden linja julkisen talouden vahvistamisesta ei Hyrkön mukaan ole muuttunut.

– Vihreät on alusta asti ollut kriittinen velkajarrua ja etenkin sen jyrkkää soveltamista kohtaan. Samaan aikaan näemme edelleen arvon laajapohjaisella yhteistyöllä ja tarpeen vahvistaa julkista taloutta, Hyrkkö sanoo.

KESKUSTELU velkajarrusta meni Hyrkön mukaan alunperin väärille raiteille, kun velkajarrusta alettiin puhua pakkopaitana. Hän uskoo, että tämä mielikuva yhdistettynä hallituksen vastuuttomaan talouspolitiikkaan on syönyt suomalaisten luottamusta politiikan kykyyn ratkoa isoja ongelmia.

title: Why ProPublica Is Leaning Into Sports Investigations
content:
If you have seen the headlines of the major investigation we recently published, “The Dominican Baseball Factory,” you may have wondered: Why is ProPublica, with its serious-sounding mission of accountability and its focus on abuses of power, reporting on baseball?

The answer would be: Exactly.

Baseball fans have long marveled at how the Dominican Republic, a tiny island nation with a population akin to Ohio, has produced so many brilliant players — roughly 10% of the major league. Major League Baseball and the owners of its 30 teams have regularly harvested bumper crops of sluggers to build their rosters and their fanbase, including most recently the Toronto Blue Jays’ Vladimir Guerrero Jr., the New York Mets’ Juan Soto and the San Diego Padres’ Fernando Tatis Jr., whose playing contracts total more than $1.6 billion.  

But as with many such tales of extraordinary success, the origin story is much darker.

title: Kremlin Vote-Fakers Crush the Liberals
content:
With Russia’s parliamentary elections now imminent, the registration and subsequent hurried removal of the liberal Yabloko’s federal list from the State Duma ballot stand out as the campaign’s most consequential event — both for democratic opposition inside and outside of the country and the Kremlin itself.

The crackdown on the only party openly calling for peace began months before the election, targeting its most prominent figures, and has continued throughout the campaign, which ends with voting from September 18-20. A recent poll by a small, independent research group with access to voters inside Russia suggests Yabloko could have won 20-25% of the vote had it remained on the ballot, challenging the Communist Party (KPRF) for second place behind United Russia.

The authorities have long had ample scope to “adjust” the ruling party’s result by transferring votes between tallies. In 2024, manipulation inflated Putin’s total by 22–25 million votes in the 2024 presidential vote, adding roughly a third to his actual vote count.

title: What I learned in Paris, the city of light: My Wikimania 2026 experiences
content:
Aside from the excitement of seeing Paris for the first time, being able to attend Wikimania this year was incredibly exciting for me, from the first day to the last. I’d like to share some key points from what I learned and experienced this year at Wikimania, which was held under the theme “Freedom, Equality, Reliability” (Liberté, Équité, Fiabilité).

As every year, this year’s opening ceremony was one of my personal favorite parts of the event. After relaxing our minds by listening to a beautiful composition at the opening, we arrived at what was perhaps the most sparkling moment of the year: the announcement of the Wikimedians of the Year. This year was a little special for me, unlike previous years. The fact that two of my young friends were honored with WOTY awards not only made us happy but also renewed our motivation as young people.

I would like to congratulate Mari, with whom I have worked many times as part of the CEE Youth Group and who was awarded an Honorable Mention, as well as Chlod, who was awarded the very first Community Connector of the Year.

title: How to Defeat Russia’s Shadow War
content:
Europe’s response to Russia’s increasingly ferocious attacks on Ukraine and a widening shadow war campaign against European NATO has been familiar: strategic restraint.

That strategy is increasingly outdated. Something new is needed.

Hybrid warfare operates in the space between strategic necessity and military constraint. Both Putin and his entourage are faced with a stalling front line, an unfolding fiscal crisis, and Ukrainian strikes reaching ever further into Russian soil that, in autocratic regime logic, demand an aggressive response, not the negotiating table. Putin must escalate, driven by the realities of regime survival, whether Europe shows restraint or not.

Jonathan Powell, the UK’s national security adviser, who helped negotiate the Good Friday Agreement in Northern Ireland nearly three decades ago, argued on September 13 that the Kremlin’s escalating reaction to Western pressure was “a sign of success” and that Europe should not “take its foot off the gas”.

While the shadow campaign against Europe does not prove Russia is buckling, it does reveal that it is willing to up the ante.

title: Das sind die Top 10 Wikipedia-Artikel im August
content:
Im August 2026 wurden folgende Artikel in der deutschsprachigen Wikipedia besonders häufig aufgerufen:

Hayden Panettiere war eine US-amerikanische Schauspielerin und Sängerin. Besonders bekannt war sie für ihre Rolle als Cheerleaderin Claire Bennet in der Fernsehserie Heroes und als Juliette Barnes in der Serie Nashville. Schon als Kleinkind übernahm Panettiere kurze Rollen in TV- und Werbespots, später sprach sie offen über ihre Probleme mit Alkoholabhängigkeit und Depressionen.

Sie wurde nur 36 Jahre alt, die Umstände ihres Todes sind aktuell noch nicht abschließend geklärt. Ihr Wikipedia-Artikel wurde im August ganze 1.364.992-mal aufgerufen.

Am 12. August kam es vorwiegend über Grönland, Island, Spanien und dem Nordpolarmeer zu einer totalen Sonnenfinsternis. Ihren Höhepunkt erreichte sie westlich von Island im Atlantik, wo die Phase der totalen Verfinsterung ganze zwei Minuten und 18 Sekunden anhielt. In der spanischen Stadt Palma dauerte sie dagegen nur noch etwa eine Minute und 30 Sekunden.

title: 2,387 photographs, 237 participants: documenting Colombia’s biodiversity through Wiki Loves Earth 2026
content:
Over two months, people across Colombia photographed landscapes, species, and protected areas for Wiki Loves Earth 2026. Together, 237 participants contributed 2,387 images to Wikimedia Commons—placing Colombia tenth internationally and second among participating Latin American countries.

But the numbers tell only part of the story. Behind those 2,387 images was a community effort built around photography, learning, partnerships, and a shared interest in documenting Colombia’s biodiversity as free knowledge.

There are places we know because we travel through them, species we discover when we learn to observe them, and territories we begin to value when we find new ways to tell their stories.

In 2026, the Wikimedia community in Colombia turned its attention to the country’s biodiversity through Wiki Loves Earth, the international photography competition that invites people to document natural areas and natural heritage and share these images as free knowledge on Wikimedia Commons.

title: Meta ordered to remove UK deepfakes as oversight board criticises ‘inadequate’ safeguards
content:
Facebook told it was wrong in leaving up AI-generated videos of a Labour councillor and Muslim campaigner, amid calls to curb fakes

Meta’s “supreme court” has ordered the tech company to take down deepfake videos of a UK politician and a young Muslim woman from Facebook and do more to tackle AI-generated fake imagery.

A fake video showing a Labour party councillor in Scotland making inflammatory comments about refugees should not have been left up by Facebook, the board said. It also ruled that an AI-generated video of a Muslim campaign volunteer should have been removed after it falsely depicted her offering health advice while carrying out absurd exercises or eating junk food.

title: GoodBrother: not every brother is big
content:
On World Patient Safety Day, 17 September, we often think about preventing medical errors, infections or other risks in healthcare. But for older people living independently, safety can also mean knowing that help will arrive when something goes wrong, without giving up privacy, dignity or control.

This is where smart technology could make a difference. But it also raises an uncomfortable question: how much monitoring is too much?

The COST Action GoodBrother explored how cameras, microphones and artificial intelligence could support older people while respecting their fundamental right to privacy.

Imagine living alone in your eighties. A small camera could detect if you fall. A microphone could recognise signs of trouble and alert a carer. Smart technologies like these have enormous potential to help older people to live independently for longer.

But there is a problem. As soon as cameras and microphones enter the home, many people start to worry. Who can access the recordings? Who owns the data? Could helpful technology start to feel more like surveillance?

title: Växtbaserade alternativ till mejeriprodukter är i huvudsak säkra, men mer forskning behövs
content:
Växtbaserade alternativ till mejeriprodukter och veganska desserter som säljs i Finland håller i huvudsak en god livsmedelssäkerhetsnivå. Enligt den riskbedömning som genomfördes inom VEGETURVA-projektet av Livsmedelsverket och VTT var de mikrobiologiska riskerna i allmänhet mycket låga, och halterna av de undersökta mykotoxinerna låg under kvantifieringsgränserna. Samtidigt visar resultaten att konsumenternas förvaringspraxis, produkternas råvaror och förekomsten av vissa skadliga ämnen kan ha betydelse för säkerheten.

Användningen av växtbaserade alternativ till mejeriprodukter har ökat snabbt under de senaste åren. Trots att produkternas näringsmässiga egenskaper har undersökts ingående finns det fortfarande betydligt mindre information om deras livsmedelssäkerhet. Inom VEGETURVA-projektet, som genomfördes i samarbete mellan Livsmedelsverket och VTT, kartlades mikrobiologiska och kemiska risker i växtdrycker, fermenterade växtbaserade produkter och veganska desserter samt säkerhetsaspekter kopplade till deras användning.

title: Jeffrey Barrettin tavoitteena on sairauksien havaitseminen aiemmin ja tarkemmin
content:
Jeffrey Barrett, the new Professor of Computational Predictive Medicine at the University of Helsinki and ELLIS Institute Finland, has a career spanning genomics, public health and industry. He uses AI methods and large-scale health data to identify practical and clinically relevant biomarkers.

For Barrett, the professorship represents a return to academia after several years in industry, but also an opportunity to bring new ways of thinking into academic research.

"I've been fortunate to have worked both in academia and in companies, and I think there is a lot we can learn from both worlds," he says.

Computational predictive medicine combines large-scale health data, molecular measurements and advanced AI methods to uncover biological signatures of disease. Rather than simply predicting who may become ill, the goal is to recognise emerging disease processes earlier and identify the patients most likely to benefit from preventive treatments.

title: “Eluteelt, Eva Lille. Kultuurisilla ehitaja” Jupiteris
content:
Sirp 35 aastat tagasi: 10.5.1991 Eval on juubel.

Legendaarne kultuurisilla ehitaja ja tugisammas Eva Lille tähistas tänavu 85. sünnipäeva. Soome Instituudil Eestis täitus 35. tegevusaasta. Instituudi sünnile ja algusaegade tegevusele andis ka Eva hiiglasliku panuse. Üle kuuekümne aasta Soome-Eesti sillal tegutsenud Eva unikaalne intervjuu on nüüd vaatamiseks Jupiteris.

1941. aastal sündinud Eva Lille on tuntud eesti kirjanduse soome keelde tõlkijana ning olulise eestvedajana Soome ja Eesti vaheliste sidemete avanemisel. Ta hakkas tooma eesti kultuuri suletud nõukogude ühiskonna varjudest soomlaste teadvusse ja aitas ühtlasi rajada alust sidemete sõlmimisele nende kahe maa vahel. Ta oli üks neist, kes asutasid Helsingi Tuglas-seura, mille büroo muutus 1991. aasta Moskva ebaõnnestunud riigipöördekatse ajal ”Eesti esimeseks välisministeeriumiks”.

title: Cross-border community in action: How the Historic Centre of Stolberg (Germany) came back to life
content:
After a mass flood in mid-July 2021 devastated the Historic Centre of Stolberg in the western part of Germany, causing severe damage to hundreds of buildings, the centre of the 500-year-old town was listed among the 7 Most Endangered heritage sites in Europe for 2022. Since its involvement in the 7 Most Endangered Programme run by Europa Nostra, the Historic Centre of Stolberg  has not only been successfully rebuilt, but strengthened its network and community in the process — a completely unexpected, and very welcome outcome of the selection. Europa Nostra sat down with Dr. Karl Schmeer, Chemist and Biologist, who was involved in the nomination of the site for the 7 Most Endangered Programme, to hear about the Historic Centre of Stolberg’s inspiring journey.

It was a bad situation, the Historic Centre of Stolberg was badly flooded. It happened at an unexpected time. It was mid-July, and it had been raining for six weeks, when suddenly two meters of water flooded the main streets. It was dangerous and rough. This was a wakeup call, everyone’s talking about climate change and the effects and now we saw it. Two days later, the city centre was devastated.

title: 10 proyectos de patrimonio del norte de México reciben apoyos
content:
The Heritage Management Organization (HERITΛGE) se complace en anunciar los 10 proyectos seleccionados para recibir apoyo a través de HerMaP México, su principal iniciativa para fortalecer la gestión del patrimonio cultural en la región fronteriza del norte de México.

Los proyectos seleccionados representan a Baja California, Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, Nuevo León y Tamaulipas, garantizando así la representación de los seis estados que conforman el ámbito geográfico de HerMaP México en esta primera convocatoria de apoyos.

Los proyectos fueron seleccionados entre 115 solicitudes recibidas a través de una convocatoria abierta lanzada a principios de 2026, reflejando tanto la extraordinaria riqueza del patrimonio cultural de la región como el compromiso de las comunidades, profesionales e instituciones que trabajan para salvaguardarlo.

title: Lappeenrannan kaupunginorkesterin konsertissa Katseet kamariin tarkastellaan naissäveltäjien johdolla tanssillisuutta ja energiavirtoja
content:
Torstaina 24.9.2026 klo 18 Lappeenrannan kaupunginorkesterin kamarikonsertti Katseet kamariin johdattelee kuulijan tarkastelemaan musiikin tanssillisuutta ja energiavirtoja. Illan aikana kuullaan kaupunginorkesterin yhtyeiden esittämänä viisi sävellystä, joissa kohtaavat esikuvat ja niistä innostuksen saaneet teokset.

Ohjelmiston sävellyksistä kolme on yhdysvaltalaisten naissäveltäjien teoksia: Nykysäveltäjän Caroline Shaw'n (s. 1982) jousiorkesteriteos Entr'acte, Joan Towerin (s. 1938) teos Rising sekä itseoppineen säveltäjän Amy Beachin (1867–1944) Teema ja variaatiot op. 80.

– Konsertti rakentuu esikuvien vaikutukseen kolmen naissäveltäjän teoksissa, joissa Ludwig van Beethoven ja Igor Stravinsky ovat eräänlaisina kummisetinä näille säveltäjille. Lisäksi nämä säveltäjät vievät erilaisilla musiikin tyyleillään kuulijan pohtimaan tanssillisuutta ja energiavirtojen siirtymistä sävellyksissään, kuvailee Lappeenrannan kaupunginorkesterin intendentti Milko Vesalainen.

Vesalainen kertoo, että illan aikana kuultavassa Igor Stravinskyn klassikossa Basel -konsertossa jousille soi niin tanssilliset liike-elementit kuin energiavirtojen muuntuminen.
